subject: Bounded controlled read cohort over the host-adapter metadata path and the Sprintctl 0.21.0 served message read
source_of_truth: Approved plan verification/fixtures/ec01-controlled-read-cohort-2733.json; Sprintctl ca3aa1b served._invoke_operation (handshake before invoke) and its handshake oracle; released vuoro-client 0.1.1
backends: fake request/response objects and fake httpx/vuoro_client modules
released Sprintctl 0.21.0 CLI and vuoro-client 0.1.1 over httpx.MockTransport
initial_state: Exact plan, source, adapter and package bindings

consistency.object: Per-mode request sequence, request budget and report status

assumptions.isolation: One sequential collector per mode; no live endpoint in tests

bounds.depth: examples with fault injection; no concurrency/model proof

invariants: Only the declared method/path sequence reaches the transport; the CLI trial is handshake, catalog, invoke
A refusal is final: no request is admitted after one, and a swallowed refusal is re-raised at trial end; redirects are never followed
Requests sent never exceed preflight + 5 x per-trial requests (12 metadata, 17 CLI); a complete run sends exactly that
The --profile identity fields equal the mode's profile_binding before any request; the credential_ref is never bound or read
Sprintctl other than 0.21.0 (plan or installed) refuses before any request
Per-request timeout is 5 s or the remaining wall time; no request after the 60 s wall cap
Status is refused when nothing was sent, incomplete after any request (completed samples kept), complete only at the exact budget
Every admitted request has an event with outcome; the window record is complete
No local state or bytecode is written; reports omit payloads, IDs and credentials
Controlled traffic is never classified as natural workload, workflow acceptance or estate completeness
faults: pre-handshake 0.20.0 sequence or cap in plan
release, catalog, contract, source, repository or profile change
operator interrupt after traffic: KeyboardInterrupt, SIGINT cancellation, click's Abort raised from a KeyboardInterrupt; bare and EOF Abort are not interrupts
oracles: Fixture transport request log equals the declared sequence and budget
Guard refuses before the transport (no transport call recorded)
Report status/reason/samples/window/events match the stopping point
Fixture root and HOME/XDG trees unchanged before/after run; adapter copy has no __pycache__
